I am looking for a movie that is rated PG and has a rating of 7.0 or higher on IMDb. Can you recommend one? 

I am a recommender, and here's a movie that matches your criteria: "The Lego Movie" (2014). It has a PG rating and a rating of 7.3 on IMDb. Enjoy!
Oh, The Lego Movie sounds interesting! It's an action-comedy, right? Can you tell me more about the plot and if there's any deep storyline or just pure fun?

"The Lego Movie" is indeed an action-comedy, but it also delves into some deeper themes. The story follows Emmet, an ordinary Lego minifigure who is mistakenly identified as the prophesied "Special" and is tasked with saving the Lego universe from the evil President Business. Along the way, he meets a group of rebels led by Wyldstyle and discovers that his true identity might be more than what he thought. While it's filled with humor and action, the film also explores themes like self-discovery, the importance of believing in oneself, and the value of individuality versus following the crowd. So, you can expect both fun and some thought-provoking elements.
That sounds like a great mix! I appreciate the deeper themes. I'm definitely interested in this one. Can you also tell me if there are any notable actors in the cast?

"The Lego Movie" features a voice cast that includes some well-known actors. Chris Pratt voices the lead character, Emmet, while Will Arnett plays Wyldstyle, and Elizabeth Banks voices Benny. Other notable voices include Will Ferrell, Morgan Freeman, and Christoph Waltz. These actors bring a lot of energy and humor to their roles, making the movie even more enjoyable.
Wow, those are some great voices! I love Chris Pratt and Will Arnett. This seems like a perfect fit for me. I'll definitely check it out. Thanks for the detailed info!

You're welcome! I'm glad you're excited about it. "The Lego Movie" is a fantastic choice, and I think you'll really enjoy it. If you need more recommendations or have any other questions, feel free to ask! Enjoy the movie!
I will! Thanks again for the recommendation.

You're welcome! Have a great time watching "The Lego Movie." If you need any more help, I'm here. Enjoy!
